hypotheses.O1_continuous_fit_improves_heldout_fishe: For both parity-split fits, continuous rank eight reduces opposite-half Fisher score error by at least 15% relative to the Frobenius rank-eight subspace.
hypotheses.O2_continuous_fit_improves_external_mean: The primary continuous fit reduces mean exact KL by at least 10% relative to Frobenius rank eight on every external corpus.
hypotheses.O3_continuous_fit_improves_external_medi: The primary continuous fit reduces median exact KL by at least 10% relative to Frobenius rank eight on every external corpus.
hypotheses.O4_independent_fits_recover_same_subspac: The two parity-split optimized rank-eight subspaces have mean canonical cosine at least 0.80.
hypotheses.O5_improvement_replicates_across_fits: Both independently optimized fits have lower mean exact KL than Frobenius rank eight on every external corpus.
hypotheses.O6_continuous_rank8_reaches_behavioral_g: The primary continuous rank-eight fit has median exact KL at most 0.005 on every corpus.
